name: Stripe
description: Takes card payments through Stripe Checkout and confirms them from a signed webhook.

config.label: Secret key
config.hint: The sk_live or sk_test key. Never the publishable one.

config.label: Webhook signing secret
config.hint: The whsec_ value Stripe shows when the endpoint is created. Without it a payment can be taken and never confirmed.

config.label: API base
config.hint: Left alone unless a test harness stands in for Stripe.
